# PRV-MIN-01

**Is every personal data set needed for a goal the design states, and does the design hold no more of it, and for no longer, than that goal needs?**

| | |
|---|---|
| Lens | [Privacy by design](privacy.md) 0.1.0 |
| Area | MIN: Purpose and minimisation |
| Default severity | major |
| Decided by | A reviewer |
| Reads | `data`, `drivers.goals` |

## Why it matters

Data minimisation and purpose limitation are judged against the design's purpose; a tool can see the data sets but not whether each one is needed.

## Sources

- Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Article 5, principles relating to processing of personal data. (`gdpr-5`)
- Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), Article 25, data protection by design and by default. (`gdpr-25`)
- European Data Protection Board, Guidelines 4/2019 on Article 25 Data Protection by Design and by Default, version 2.0 (2020). (`edpb-25`)
